about.description: Anchored Finance is a blockchain-based platform providing infrastructure for tokenization and on-chain financial services. It enables users to access and trade diverse digital assets through decentralized protocols.
about.registryInfo: Anchored Finance is a stablecoin / asset tokenization platform issuing yield-bearing tokens backed by RWA collateral (treasuries, MMF holdings).

fees.revenueNotes: Anchored earns the spread between underlying treasury yields and the yield passed through to token holders (estimated ~25-100 bps depending on product). No protocol token disclosed.
